items.title: Ascletis’ challenger to Lilly’s Foundayo hits goals in phase 2 diabetes trial
items.summary: A phase 2 trial of Ascletis’ oral GLP-1 drug candidate has hit its primary and secondary endpoints, positioning the Chinese biotech to mount a two-front attack on Eli Lilly’s Foundayo.

items.title: Genmab's $8B Merus bet delivers as bispecific combo halves risk of death in phase 3
items.summary: Capping off a busy few days in Spain, Genmab reported results from the first interim analysis of a phase 3 trial showing that adding its bispecific antibody petosemtamab to Merck & Co.'s Keytruda cut the risk of death by 50% compared with Keytruda alone in patients with PD-L1-positive recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.

items.title: FDA’s rare disease framework aims to ‘stand the test of time’
items.summary: During a public hearing Wednesday to discuss a newly proposed rare disease framework, FDA center director Michael Davis, M.D., Ph.D., said the agency aims to design a scheme that “stands the test of time.”

items.title: Biogen CEO tells analysts he’s focused on early-stage R&D as ‘we were not very good with that’
items.summary: Biogen's CEO has pointed to the company's ability to take five drugs into clinical trials so far this year as evidence of its new focus on early-stage R&D.

items.title: ‘The patient need is enormous’: Syntax programs stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in 4 days
items.summary: Chicago-based Syntax Bio believes it has cracked the code for turning stem cells into pancreatic beta cells in as little as four days.

items.title: Lilly’s retatrutide bests Ozempic on blood sugar, weight loss in phase 3 diabetes showdown
items.summary: Eli Lilly’s triple-G drug candidate retatrutide has beaten Novo’s Ozempic in a head-to-head phase 3 trial, driving deeper reductions in blood sugar and body weight across the 80-week study.

items.title: HCPs Aren’t Ignoring Your Science. They’re Ignoring How (and When) You Deliver It
items.summary: Make your congress investment work harder. Discover how the right format can deliver 180% more engaged sessions.

items.title: Proof Over Promise: What a DTP Program Actually Looks Like When It's Working
items.summary: The DTP space is full of providers making bold claims. But claims aren’t outcomes. Find out what a high-performing DTP program actually delivers.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Sun's Ilumya wins FDA expansion; Bayer's FXIa inhibitor gets world-1st nod in China
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: As Skyrizi and Rinvoq dominate AbbVie's Q3, analysts ask what's next
items.summary: Analysts were eager to learn more about AbbVie's plans beyond immunology as Rinvoq and Skyrizi headlined the Chicago drugmaker's third-quarter earnings.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo, Wegovy pill rally toward previous records
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

items.title: As Dupixent keeps sales churning, Sanofi doubles down on R&D re-work
items.summary: Amid a push to win back investor confidence in its R&D trajectory, Sanofi still has significant commercial powder to burn with Dupixent, as illustrated in a third-quarter showing that looked strong by the numbers and lifted the French drugmaker’s share price nearly 4% Friday morning.

items.title: AstraZeneca launches $1.5B savings plan to fuel pipeline growth, says workforce won't shrink
items.summary: Facing looming patent cliffs, AstraZeneca has launched a restructuring initiative aimed at saving $1.5 billion annually by 2029. But executives said the overhaul won't result in a net reduction in jobs.

items.title: Pfizer looks to reroute supply after flooding sidelined India injectables plant
items.summary: A Pfizer joint venture with Zydus Cadila in India that manufactures sterile injectables, including chemotherapy drugs for U.S. cancer patients, remains closed after severe flooding in July, with the company estimating that new supplies could begin returning in mid-to-late 2028 under a best-case scenario.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—The hunt for Enhertu’s successor; ESMO data from Merck, BMS, Takeda and more
items.summary: Next-generation ADCs, bispecifics, radiopharmaceuticals, TKIs ... Fierce provides a deep dive into the hunt for the next Enhertu in breast cancer. ESMO 2026 data featured Chinese assets backed by Big Pharma. Gilead and Astellas struck $1 billion-plus deals for immunology and immuno-oncology assets. And more.

items.title: Lilly breaks down Medicare Bridge boon as GLP-1 sales drive another guidance lift
items.summary: As Lilly’s tirzepatide franchise continues to deliver strong sales growth, analysts are increasingly turning their attention to new catalysts in the GLP-1 market, including the launch of oral obesity medicines and the rollout of a nationwide access program for seniors.

items.title: Lenz reports 75% workforce cut, CEO shakeup alongside Q3 earnings update
items.summary: In a massive overhaul of its operating expenses, Lenz is set to reduce staff by 75% before the new year.

items.title: AZ takes a 'time out' with former teen TV star in biomarker testing push
items.summary: AZ is encouraging people impacted by cancer to "Meet Your Mark" with the help of biomarker testing and “Saved by the Bell” actor Mark-Paul Gosselaar.

items.title: Women 'still waiting' for healthcare to earn their trust: report
items.summary: 73% of women polled in a 1,000-person survey have felt dismissed or not taken seriously by providers due to their gender, a new report from Langrand found.

items.title: Bristol Myers' Cobenfy performance called into question amid overall Q3 revenue beat
items.summary: BMS' novel-mechanism schizophrenia drug, Cobenfy, underwhelmed in the third quarter, pulled back by inventory issues, access barriers and side effects.

items.title: Lonza rounds out Swiss ADC expansion's scope with mid-scale capabilities
items.summary: Several months after telegraphing a major antibody-drug conjugate manufacturing expansion in its native Switzerland, CDMO Lonza is laying out fresh details and growing the project’s scope.

items.title: Kennedy's HHS relaxes enforcement on 6 popular wellness peptides
items.summary: Stopping short of a formal declaration allowing their use, Department of Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has cleared the way for the compounding of six popular wellness peptides.

items.title: 'Numbers speak for themselves': Biogen's Apellis buyout fuels best quarter since 2020
items.summary: Biogen CEO Chris Viehbacher said, "We're dramatically changing Biogen" on third quarter earnings call where the biotech announced revenue increase 11% year-over-yera.

items.title: After GSK's Q3 approval spate, Hibsago preps for 'concentrated' US hep B launch
items.summary: Armed with a trio of recent high-profile approvals, GSK is banking on its specialty medicines to drive its next wave of growth, even as investor enthusiasm cooled Wednesday morning amid reports of restructuring charges and a vaccine sales dip at the British drugmaker.

items.title: Lilly combines global markets under new leadership role as 36-year veteran retires
items.summary: Eli Lilly is consolidating its U.S. and international commercial divisions into a unified department, tapping current U.S. head Ilya Yuffa in a newly created role as president of Lilly Global Markets.

items.title: GSK vows not to ‘park crap on Page 41’ in transparency push
items.summary: GSK CEO Luke Miels has committed to a transparent communication strategy, telling analysts that “we are not going to park crap on Page 41 of a press release and hope none of you notice it.”

items.title: Blue Matter ‘turbocharges’ global reach of comms agency Cognite with acquisition
items.summary: The deal stands to "turbocharge" Cognite's global reach and growth opportunities, chief business officer Sean Cush pointed out.

items.title: Amgen hit with FDA warning letter for ‘misleading’ Vectibix promotion
items.summary: Amgen has been handed an FDA warning letter over a video promoting its cancer drug Vectibix, but the company said that the issues stemmed from an “inadvertent” submission and was not made available publicly.
